payload.body: Next for you, before WP13 (vc decision 10, ruling todo 5): one About reader for every About read. It decodes lossily, so a non-UTF-8 About keeps its header as the legacy's byte-wise reads did. A read error other than NotFound fails the command naming the file, returned to the coordinator, never printed by the library (PFIC). NotFound stays 'no About'. Sites: tree.rs's header read and its .index/aliases read, grep.rs:90, sync.rs:1177 (--pull then names the real cause instead of 'no About file'), tags.rs:681 and :906. Tests red then green: a non-UTF-8 About's header still reads; an unreadable About fails naming its path. No golden changes expected; tell me first if one moves. Measure once with cargo and bats; my checklist is todo 7. Then WP13.
